digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and publication seam
propositions: Repository delegation must maintain clear ownership boundaries between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring the seam.
Publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state files; repository checkpoints must never publish independently.
Unchanged passes must create no commit; GET rotation and retired-first publication must preserve pre-extraction floors and recovery behavior.
ADR 0099 must document repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback decisions, and explicit rejections of journal, format migration, and deep copies.
Existing five-file allowlist, unchanged-pass behavior, rotation floor, and retired-first publication semantics must remain intact across the S1 cutover with regression test coverage.
